title: Coconut Peanut Satay Sauce
summary: Garlic and sugar warmed in oil, simmered with coconut milk and peanut butter, sharpened with lime and soy and topped with chopped peanuts and chilli.

ingredients.item: chilli sauce such as sambal oelek, to drizzle

steps.title: Warm the aromatics
steps.text: Heat the oil in the saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic and sugar and stir for about 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer. Whisk in the peanut butter until smooth and glossy.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat and stir in the lime juice, soy sauce and most of the chopped peanuts. Add warm water a spoonful at a time if it is too thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon into a bowl, swirl the chilli sauce over the top and scatter with the rest of the peanuts. Serve warm or at room temperature with grilled chicken skewers.

tips: The sauce thickens as it cools; loosen with warm water.
Use crunchy peanut butter for more texture.
Add a pinch of chilli flakes for more heat.
Light coconut milk gives a thinner sauce.
storage: Refrigerate in a covered container for up to 4 days. Warm gently and thin with water before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
